run_hydra_app: run the Hydra app my_app to print the resolved configuration as YAML
run_experiment_config: run my_app with experiment=nglite to override server to nginx and db to sqlite
run_experiment_aplite: run my_app with experiment=aplite to override db to sqlite and set server port to 8080
review_hydra_config_groups: review the Hydra config groups for db, server, and experiment in the conf directory
summarize_omegaconf_yaml: summarize how OmegaConf.to_yaml prints the resolved DictConfig as YAML output
